lines.text: Did pirates really make you walk the plank?
A plank, a sword, a shark. Just like the stories!
But real pirates wanted one thing: your cargo.
Their black flag was meant to scare a ship into giving up without a fight.
Someone in the way? Over the side. No plank needed.
A pirate who cheated his crew was left on an empty island.
Walking the plank is almost never recorded. It comes from stories like Treasure Island and Peter Pan.
And pirates had rules: lose a limb in battle, and the crew paid you eight hundred pieces of eight.
